# Wilson Kehoe Winingham Injury Lawyers

> > Indianapolis-based personal injury law firm specializing in complex cases including medical malpractice, wrongful death, and accident claims with a track record of significant settlements.

Wilson Kehoe Winingham (WKW) is a full-service personal injury law firm based in Indianapolis, Indiana, led by experienced attorneys Bruce Kehoe, Bill Winingham, Jon Noyes, and Kent Winingham. The firm handles cases across Indiana with expertise in medical malpractice, birth injuries, product liability, and various accident claims.
